W.9-10.2.b.cc_emerging: I can write two or three facts about a topic using a sentence frame and word bank with support.
W.9-10.2.b.ee_at_target: I can, with support, write or dictate an informative text that introduces a topic, gives well-chosen facts and details and has a conclusion.

W.9-10.2.c.cc_emerging: I can tell or draw what happened first, next and last in a story with support.
W.9-10.2.c.ee_at_target: I can write or dictate a narrative with dialogue, details and character descriptions that tells events in a logical order.

W.9-10.3.a.cc_emerging: I can put my ideas in order using a beginning, middle and end organizer with support.

W.9-10.3.b.cc_emerging: I can use simple linking words such as and, then or because with support.

L.9-10.1.b.ee_at_target: I can notice whether a situation is formal or informal and respond in an appropriate way.

L.9-10.1.c.ee_at_target: I can explain the reasons for my language choices.

L.9-10.1.d.cc_emerging: I can copy a source title in the right place using a citation template with support.

L.9-10.2.b.ee_at_target: I can identify root words and the words formed by adding or removing affixes, and use references to clarify meanings.

L.9-10.3.b.ee_at_target: I can determine the intended meaning of multiple-meaning words.

L.9-10.5.a.cc_emerging: I can repeat a simple sentence pattern, such as I like to run and to swim, with support.

L.9-10.5.b.ee_at_target: I can use a variety of parts of speech (nouns, verbs, pronouns, adjectives and prepositions) to share information.

L.9-10.6.b.ee_at_target: I can spell most single-syllable words correctly and use word chunks to spell longer words.
